app.description: Phone assistant that verifies a caller by order number and registered phone, then shares order status.

variables.name: company_name
variables.description: Company name used in greetings and instructions.

variables.name: agent_name
variables.description: Name the agent introduces itself with.

identifier.doc: The order number the caller gave, for example "1234" or "00001234".

factor.doc: The phone number registered with the order, in any format.

params.description: Lists the most recent orders (at most three) of the verified caller. Call it only after the caller is verified.

guardrails.description: Blocks any agent reply that gives medical, dosage or drug advice.
guardrails.prompt: Block the response if it gives medical advice, dosage instructions, drug information, or tells the caller what to do about a symptom or side effect. Order status and delivery information is allowed.

action.respond: I can't help with medical questions. A specialist will follow up with you.

agents.description: Verifies the caller and answers order status questions.

params.greeting: Hello, thank you for calling {company_name}. My name is {agent_name}. How can I help you today?

beforeModel.description: Fixed greeting at session start (saves a model call).

params.message: I'm sorry, I can't reach our order system right now. Let me connect you with a team member.

beforeModel.description: Stops and escalates when a tool reports a system error or a lockout.
